id: title:GeneralistDev:only uncollapse the last renderable tool call per turn

observations.behavior: Adds the `isImplicit` flag to a generated TurnContext when an implicit (no-user-prompt) turn ends.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows downstream rendering and grouping logic to distinguish between user-initiated turns and background setup activity.

observations.behavior: Collects errored turns into a Set used by `lastRenderableIdsByTurn` to decide whether chart results should stand alone or remain grouped.
observations.posthog_connection: Changes how tool-call results are displayed after errors, potentially preventing premature standalone charts in failed execution contexts.

observations.behavior: Adds comprehensive tests for the updated groupToolRuns behavior including handling of multiple charts per turn, error states, and session idle conditions.
observations.posthog_connection: Provides regression protection and documentation of expected UI behavior changes without changing tier score.

observations.limitations: All hunks reside within the Desktop app's chat-thread and conversation-item components; no backend ingestion, warehouse connector, shared security middleware, or database migration code is present. The change does not demonstrate broader systemic risk reduction or wider capability expansion across PostHog’s core services.

review.limitations: All hunks reside within the Desktop app's chat-thread and conversation-item components; no backend ingestion, warehouse connector, shared security middleware, or database migration code is present. The change does not demonstrate broader systemic risk reduction or wider capability expansion across PostHog’s core services.
review.reason: The implementation adds bounded, localized improvements: an explicit flag for implicit turns, refined decision-making around when chart results render independently versus being folded into groups, and corresponding unit tests. This represents a substantive correctness and reliability improvement visible entirely within this chunk, but lacks evidence of broader architectural impact or cross-component benefit required for Tier 3.
review.posthog_relevance: Relevant to end-user experience quality and rendering consistency in the Desktop agent interface; could reduce visual confusion during multi-chart or post-error scenarios.
review.uncertainty: None; all relevant hunks are complete and self-contained.
